sentences.en: I spent years trying to learn Berber without gaining fluency.
sentences.zh: 我花了好几年时间学习柏柏语却始终未能流利。

sentences.en: It took me forty years to reach fluency in Berber.
sentences.zh: 我用了四十年的时间才在柏柏语上达到流利水平。

sentences.en: His speech was pleased by its accuracy, felicity, and fluency.
sentences.zh: 他的演讲因其准确、得体和流利而令人满意。
